answer: One concrete mechanism: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because yarrow only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, relic is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any jetty approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
